Communication - Translate insights into crisp, opinionated recommendations that marketing leaders actually use — written and verbal. - Set the bar for experimentation rigor and marketing measurement quality at OpenArt. 🧑‍💻 What We're Looking For Core Requirements - 3–6 years of experience in data science, analytics, or marketing science.
